label: preparing
what: The innkeeper, Freight and builder are coordinating a community meal in the town hall great hall at eighteen hundred. I have been told about the meal but not its full purpose or arrangements; the insistence on arriving at six sharp, not earlier, suggests an undisclosed element, though a surprise is not confirmed. Secretary knowingly helps coordinate my attendance; baker appears to be helping with bread, supported by the fundraising report and lantern transfer.
